data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Dashboard
features.description: Implement a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for live metrics.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is shown as a line chart.
Stage completion rates are displayed as a bar chart.
Success rate trends are visualized as an area chart.

features.title: Feature Metrics Visualization
features.description: Display metrics for cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Cost tracking metrics are visualized with charts.
Sandboxing metrics are clearly displayed.
Learning metrics are represented using Chart.js.

features.title: Interactive Elements and Animations
features.description: Enhance the presentation with Chart.js animations and interactive elements.
acceptance_criteria: Charts include animations to engage the audience.
Interactive elements allow users to explore data.
The presentation remains responsive and smooth.

features.title: Code Quality Visualization
features.description: Visualize TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: TDD compliance is represented in the radar chart.
SOLID principles are visualized effectively.
The radar chart is clear and informative.

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
acceptance_criteria: Each stage of the pipeline is represented in the visualization.
The pipeline visualization is clear and easy to understand.
Chart.js is used to enhance the visual representation.

features.title: Results Slide with Real Metrics
features.description: Display real metrics from recent runs in the results slide.
acceptance_criteria: The results slide shows actual data from recent runs.
Metrics are presented in a clear and concise manner.
The slide effectively communicates the success of Artemis.

features.title: Chart.js Visualization Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates within the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking is displayed with appropriate charts.
Success rates are shown using Chart.js visualizations.

features.title: HERO Slide: Introduction to Artemis
features.description: Create a HERO slide that introduces Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: The HERO slide clearly explains what Artemis is.
The slide is visually engaging and informative.
The introduction sets the context for the rest of the presentation.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Include functionality for auto-advancing slides with navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set period.
Users can manually navigate between slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: HTML Presentation Creation
features.description: Develop a standalone HTML file that includes embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: The HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js is included for data visualization.

features.title: Professional Design and Transitions
features.description: Implement a professional gradient background and smooth transitions for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: A gradient background is applied to the presentation.
Transitions between slides are smooth and professional.
The design aligns with the overall branding of Artemis.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Supervisor integration is represented with a pie chart.
The chart accurately reflects integration data.
Chart.js is used for the visualization.
